metadata.summary: Britain's Sonay Kartal has stormed into the semi-finals of the Wuhan Open - a WTA 1000 event - in just her third tournament back from injury.
metadata.content: Sonay Kartal: Brit breaks new ground by upsetting Elina Svitolina to reach Wuhan Open semi-finals | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Sonay Kartal: Brit breaks new ground by upsetting Elina Svitolina to reach Wuhan Open semi-finals Sonay Kartal will play Jelena Ostapenko in last four of WTA 1000 event in China; watch WTA Wuhan Open and ATP 1000 Shanghai Masters live on Sky Sports Friday 16 October 2026 09:04, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights of the Wuhan Open quarter-final between Sonay Kartal and Elina Svitolina Britain's Sonay Kartal has stormed into the semi-finals of the Wuhan Open - a WTA 1000 event - in just her third tournament back from injury. Will Lutz kicked a 53-yard field goal to win it at Mile High Stadium to move Denver to 4-2 and drop the defending champion Seahawks to 3-3. metadata.content: SE Dons: How the YouTube football sensation went from Sunday League to one win away from FA Cup first-round history | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content SE Dons: How the YouTube football sensation went from Sunday League to one win away from FA Cup first-round history SE Dons: Don Strapzy and Alex Teniola speak to William Bitibiri at Sky Sports as the club that started as a Sunday League team on YouTube chase FA Cup history; Beat Sholing on Satuday and they reach the first round proper, with Leicester among potential opponents William Bitibiri Football Journalist @williambitibiri Friday 16 October 2026 08:59, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Speaking to Sky Sports' William Bitibiri SE Dons owner Don Strapzy showed that his side are not ,shy about their FA Cup ambitions "Some things don't need commentary." For years, Don Strapzy has said it while watching the SE Dons, his words becoming part of the soundtrack to a football club built on ambition, personality and a belief that the game belongs to everybody. But when Alex Teniola scored in the 95th minute to complete a remarkable comeback against Chichester, the phrase found a new audience. The Dons had trailed 2-1 before scoring twice in added time to win 3-2. Don Strapzy's commentary went viral, capturing the kind of footballing drama that needs no embellishment. metadata.summary: Manchester United defender Lisandro Martinez has issued an apology for his outburst after Tuesday's Champions League loss at Atletico Madrid.
metadata.content: Lisandro Martinez: Man Utd defender apologises for outburst and holds talks with Jason Wilcox and Michael Carrick | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Lisandro Martinez: Man Utd defender apologises for outburst and holds talks with Jason Wilcox and Michael Carrick Man Utd defender Lisandro Martinez called out the club's hierarchy after their Champions League loss at Atletico Madrid; Martinez said he had expected more from "upstairs", singling out technical director Jason Wilcox Thursday 15 October 2026 21:58, UK Manchester United defender Lisandro Martinez has issued an apology for his outburst after Tuesday's Champions League loss at Atletico Madrid. Martinez launched an extraordinary attack on the club's hierarchy after the 2-0 defeat in Spain, as he criticised the lack of summer investment in the squad and said he expected more from "upstairs" after he singled out technical director Jason Wilcox. Sky Sports News understands Martinez met the club's hierarchy, including Wilcox and CEO Omar Berrada, on Thursday. Head coach Michael Carrick was also present at the meeting.
